title: Public profile
summary: Turns the user's public profile on or off and edits its name and bio. The photo is the profile photo (profile-edit). Anyone with the link bipe.chat/@handle sees it; it is not in any search (ADR 0041).

handle.description: The text in the field, without the fixed @.

problem.description: socialHandleProblem with the user's own @: social_invalid, social_reserved or null.

handle.description: MyProfile.handle. Without it the switch is off and locked: bipe_public_profile_needs_handle.

name.description: MyProfile.name. A profile never saved starts with the Matrix display name.

of.description: One registries/profiles.json socials entry: its name, the handle the user typed (MyProfile.socials[id], empty when none) and its socialHandleProblem (none, invalid or reserved, with the user's own @).

socials.description: One field per network, in registry order (ADR 0228).

photoUrl.description: Client.avatarUrl, read only. The public page shows a copy of it (syncPhoto).

problem.description: From profileProblem: bipe_public_profile_name_empty, bipe_public_profile_name_too_long (nameMaxLength), bipe_app_profile_name_reserved, bipe_public_profile_bio_too_long (bioMaxLength), bipe_public_profile_bio_too_many_lines (bioMaxLines). Save is off unless none. A social field with a problem shows bipe_public_profile_social_invalid (argument: the network name) or bipe_public_profile_social_reserved under that field, and Save is off.

phase.description: saved: bipe_public_profile_saved. failed: bipe_error_network, or the problem the server returned (ProfileProblem).

setEnabled.effect: Updates enabled. Saved with the rest.

setSocial.effect: Updates that field and its problem (socialHandleProblem with the user's own @).

save.effect: PUT /v1/me/profile with enabled, name, bio (trimmed) and socials (every field after socialHandleClean; an empty field is left out), then syncPhoto. Then bipe_public_profile_saved.

syncPhoto.effect: Shared with profile-edit. Runs only when MyProfile.enabled. Client.avatarUrl absent and has_photo: DELETE /v1/me/profile/photo. Client.avatarUrl not equal to MyProfile.photo_source: Client.getMediaContent, square crop, JPEG (BipeProfilePhoto), PUT /v1/me/profile/photo?source=<mxc>. Else nothing. A failure shows nothing; the next run tries again.

notes: Opens from the publicProfile row of Seu perfil (settings-group profile). The row value is bipe_public_profile_on or bipe_public_profile_off.

Name and bio are separate from the Matrix profile (ADR 0041): changing them does not change profile-edit, and the other way round. The first time, the app fills the name from Client.displayName. The photo is not separate (ADR 0041, amended 2 Nov 2026): the screen shows the profile photo, and the user changes it in profile-edit.

Rules: registries/profiles.json (nameMaxLength 50, bioMaxLength 160, bioMaxLines 4, photoMaxBytes, photoMaxPixels) and the reserved names, by profileProblem in tools/lib/registries.mjs. The server is the authority and returns the same ProfileProblem ids. Bipe logic: BipePublicProfileRules and BipeProfilePhoto.jpegData (BipeKit BipePublicProfile.swift); BipePublicProfile.kt (libraries/bipe).

Photo: the API keeps a copy of the Matrix avatar, because the web page cannot read Matrix media. JPEG only, at most photoMaxPixels on each side and photoMaxBytes. The app re-encodes; the server strips every metadata segment. syncPhoto runs on appear and save here and after a photo change in profile-edit, so an avatar changed in another client reaches the public page the next time the user opens either screen.
Without a handle: the switch is locked, bipe_public_profile_needs_handle shows with bipe_handle_prompt_action, which opens handle-pick.
Turning it off hides the profile at once: GET /v1/profiles/{handle} answers 404, the same as for an unknown handle.

Social accounts (ADR 0228): a section titled bipe_public_profile_socials after the bio, one text field per registries/profiles.json socials entry labelled with its name and a fixed @ before the text, then bipe_public_profile_socials_footer. The field takes a handle, never a URL: no URL keyboard, no autocorrect, no autocapitalisation. Bipe logic: BipeSocialHandles (BipeKit, libraries/bipe), the port of socialHandleClean, socialHandleProblem and socialUrl, checked by test-vectors/social-handles.json.
